transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’ve failed my family and that everything that’s gone wrong is my fault. My wife and my cousin insisted I come talk to someone because I've just been carrying this heavy weight around.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this low or hopeless before in your life, or is this the first time you have felt this way?
No, I don't recall ever feeling this low or hopeless before in my life. This is really the first time I have ever experienced anything like this.
To what extent are these feelings interfering with your ability to perform your daily tasks, such as working, managing household chores, or taking care of your personal hygiene?

They are completely taking over my life. At work, my sales numbers have dropped so much that my manager has pulled me aside twice, and at home, I've let bills pile up and stopped organizing our family get-togethers. I mostly just keep to myself now instead of being involved with my wife and relatives like I used to.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts, such as hearing voices that others cannot hear or feeling like others are watching you or plotting against you?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I don't hear any voices, and I've never felt like anyone was watching me or plotting against me.
Have you noticed any physical changes, such as your movements becoming significantly slower than usual, or have you completely stopped eating or speaking for long periods of time?
No, I haven't noticed my movements slowing down like that, and I definitely haven't stopped eating or speaking. I still do those things, though I mostly just keep to myself these days.

Have you noticed that your energy levels or your ability to concentrate have become so low that you are unable to function at even a basic level for most of the day, or are you still able to manage some essential tasks despite your struggles?

I am still barely managing to go to work and go through the motions, but I feel completely worn out and my ability to function has severely declined. My performance has dropped so much that my manager has had to pull me aside twice, and at home, I've let bills pile up and stopped organizing our family get-togethers.

Do you feel that your ability to concentrate, your appetite, or your sleep patterns are so severely affected that you are virtually unable to perform any social or work-related activities at all, or are you still managing to force yourself to complete some basic responsibilities?

I’m forcing myself to go to work, but my sleep is so ruined that I'm barely scraping by; I lie awake for hours staring at the ceiling and wake up at 3 AM with my mind racing. Because I'm so exhausted, my work performance has slipped enough that my manager has intervened, and I've completely stopped paying bills on time or organizing family gatherings. I'm just going through the motions but avoiding almost all social activities now.

Would you say that your symptoms are so overwhelming that you are completely unable to function at work or home, or are you still able to maintain some level of daily activity despite the significant difficulty you are facing?

I wouldn't say I'm completely unable to function, but I am barely managing to get by. I still force myself to go to work, but my performance has dropped significantly and my manager has already pulled me aside twice. At home, I've let responsibilities like bills pile up and have stopped participating in family activities, mostly just keeping to myself.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient exhibits key depressive symptoms including persistent low mood, feelings of worthlessness/guilt, sleep disturbance (insomnia/early morning awakening), and fatigue. The symptoms are causing significant functional impairment in both occupational (declining work performance) and social domains, but the patient remains capable of forcing himself to perform basic tasks, consistent with a moderate depressive episode.
